testRun.output: BUILD SUCCESSFUL (37s, all targets). Added exactly one commonTest.dependencies block and one implementation(projects.dataDeviceApi) line.

implementation.summary: Four never-throwing mappers plus DeviceRepositoryImpl: emits Detecting immediately then polls every 2s. A missing adb emits ToolMissing as a success value and does NOT advance the empty-poll counter - we learned nothing about devices. AVD de-duplication consumes each match out of the running map so a listed-and-running AVD appears exactly once. nowMs is an injected clock so poll metadata is assertable under virtual time, which is why the binding is single { } and not singleOf.

troubleshooting.resolution: Default clock uses stdlib kotlin.time.Clock - no dependency added.

troubleshooting.issue: ModelResourceMapper demands a total toResource but DeviceId has a private constructor with a nullable factory.
troubleshooting.resolution: requireNotNull over a compile-time-constant literal, so no input can make a mapper throw.

needsHumanReview.reason: Two cross-batch judgement calls: detectTools() returns a hardcoded not-installed iOS ToolModel because data-device-api ships no idb datasource, so AC-1's iOS dot is a placeholder rather than a real probe; and DiscoveryModel.NoDeviceFound carries no emulator list, so the ViewModel must retain the last known one (B4 confirmed this was real and implemented the retention).
